The plain folk of the heartlands, as they have always been.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sunfreckled.desc: Freckled and sun-browned from a life in the open fields and savannas. Their skin runs warmer than other Heartlanders'.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skymarked.desc: Born in sight of a Highfield monolith. A pale swirl like a cloud marks one forearm and glows faintly by day; the old folk say the Aether's sky-meadows left it there.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skymarked.trait: Trait: falls 1 block further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn_base.de: The mountain folk, grey-skinned like the stone they mine, with amethyst in the cracks of their hands.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.obsidian.desc: Born deep, where lava meets the water. Their skin set hard and black-violet as obsidian, and it weeps the same purple tears. Extremely hardy.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.obsidian.trait: Trait: +3 armour and 20% knockback resistance, 4% slower
variant.jaymoskingdoms.magmavein.desc: Stone and ember in one: a Stoneborn line with Emberborn blood. Their basalt-dark skin is cracked with glowing magma that drips when they are dry.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.magmavein.trait: Trait: burns 60% shorter, blows land 4% harder
variant.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn_base.des: The fishfolk of the coasts and rivers, finned and gilled, lit like the deep-sea lights.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.reefcrowned.desc: From the warm seas. Coral grows in crusts over their forearms and their fins blush coral-pink.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.abyssal.desc: From the deepest water, with Deepborn blood in them: dusky blue skin, pale lure-lights and eyes that never needed the sun.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.abyssal.trait: Trait: holds their breath even longer
variant.jaymoskingdoms.greyfin.desc: Shark-blooded: grey hide gone pale at the throat, a tall fin up the spine, a hunter's tail and a mouth of too many teeth.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.greyfin.trait: Trait: +5% melee damage; no chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.mantawing.desc: Ray-blooded: dark wings of skin down the back that ripple as they walk, curled horns at the brow and a whip of a tail.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.mantawing.trait: Trait: swims more easily; no chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.eightarm.desc: Octopus-blooded: a soft mantle swelling from the back of the skull and tentacles hanging from it, suckers and all, curling as they go.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.eightarm.trait: Trait: reaches a little further; no helmet fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lanternjaw.desc: Anglerfish-blooded: a lit lure on a stalk over the brow, a jutting jaw of needle fangs and lumpy dark skin from the black depths.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lanternjaw.trait: Trait: digs faster under water; no helmet fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.driftbell.desc: Jellyfish-blooded: a clear bell over the crown, glowing at its rim, and stinging threads trailing down the back on every current.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.driftbell.trait: Trait: falls softer; no helmet fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moray.desc: Eel-blooded: green hide freckled gold, a ribbon fin from crown to spine and a long eel's tail that never quite stops moving.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moray.trait: Trait: holds their breath longer; no chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.shellclaw.desc: Crab-blooded: a spiked shell across the back, a claw of shell round each forearm and eyes up on stalks.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.shellclaw.trait: Trait: +2 armour; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.spinepuff.desc: Pufferfish-blooded: spines all over the head, back and arms, freckled yellow skin and a round, wary face.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.spinepuff.trait: Trait: +2 health; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lionmane.desc: Lionfish-blooded: a mane of striped venom spines fanning round the head, banded red and white, and fans of fin down the arms.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lionmane.trait: Trait: +5% attack speed; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.weedfrond.desc: Seadragon-blooded: leafy fronds sprouting from head, back and arms, a little crown of knobs and a tail curled up tight.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.weedfrond.trait: Trait: sneaks faster; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.swordbill.desc: Swordfish-blooded: a long bill jutting from the face, a sail fin down the back and a forked tail, blue-backed and quick.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.swordbill.trait: Trait: +4% speed; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frillback.desc: Sea-slug-blooded: bright as poison, with two frilled horns and soft finger-frills over the head and back, their tips lit in the wet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frillback.trait: Trait: +1 luck; no helmet or chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.oldshell.desc: Sea-turtle-blooded: a great domed shell on the back, a beaked mouth and scaled arms; slow, and very hard to knock down.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.oldshell.trait: Trait: +1 armour, hard to knock back, a little slower; no chestplate fits them
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan_base.desc: The forest folk, a glowing vine wound round each arm.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.thornrose.desc: Sylvans of the flower meadows. Briars bristle up their arms and red roses bloom at the wrist. Whoever strikes one up close comes away bleeding.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.thornrose.trait: Trait: melee attackers are pricked for half a heart
variant.jaymoskingdoms.blossomkin.desc: Born under the blossom trees near the Highfield monoliths, where the Aether's sky-meadows fell. Pale petals drift off them wherever they walk, and they land as lightly.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.blossomkin.trait: Trait: falls 2 blocks further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.verdant_base.desc: The green folk of the Verdant World, antennae and all.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.verdant_base.trai: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.glowcap.desc: Verdants who grew up beside an Irradiated monolith. The Ambrosium sickness on the air turned their green yellow and their patches glow like it.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.mosshide.desc: A deep-jungle line with Sylvan blood: darker, olive green, moss and lichen grown over the hands.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn_base.de: Fire under the skin of the hands, ember-gold eyes.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.soulflame.desc: Born in the Nether's soul valleys, where fire burns blue. Their embers and their eyes are soul-fire cyan.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ashen.desc: A fire that met frost and banked low: Emberborn with Frostborn blood. Ash-grey skin, cinders that only glow at night, and ash on the wind behind them.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn_base.de: Rime on the fingers, pink patches that glow in the dark.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rimeglass.desc: Born in the shadow of an Arctic monolith. Clear ice crystals have grown into the skin of their forearms, cold blue at the core.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.aurora.desc: Children of the long polar nights. Lines of shifting green and violet light run up their arms, brightest after dark.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn_base.de: Shadow soaking the hands, stars in it.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moonpale.desc: Moon-silver skin and a crescent on each hand. They are seen on the heights more than anywhere, nearer the moon.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.umbral.desc: Shadow that climbs past the elbow and never lifts, with Endborn blood somewhere back in the line. Wisps follow them day and night.
Warrior-born, plain to the eye, the tail wrapped or long cut.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.battlescarred.des: A line that has always fought. Old scars cross their forearms and one cheek.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.warpainted.desc: The old warrior clans' ochre stripes, painted on the forearms and the face from childhood.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.earthling_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ironknuckle.desc: Taped fingers and knuckles hardened to callus by a thousand strikes against posts and stone.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.inkmarked.desc: Dojo tattoos: bands of ink round the forearms, one for each teacher.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lodeborn.desc: Born near a Magnetic monolith. Iron-dark lines run their arms like filings round a lodestone, and their sparks crackle violet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.galeborn.desc: Sky-swirled from the Highfields, white cloud lines up their arms; wisps of cloud trail them on the heights.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.galeborn.trait: Trait: falls 2 blocks further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn_base.des: A gold sun-ring on each hand.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.twilight.desc: Dawnborn with Nightborn blood: a gold sun on one hand and a silver moon on the other.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.desc: Gold-leaf flecks over the hands and cheeks, like the badlands' gold. Their eyes catch the light by day.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.endborn_base.trai: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.chorusgrown.desc: Chorus has grown into their hands in pale purple knots. They hum, faintly, when it is quiet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.voidpale.desc: Grey-lilac skin, black void-specks, dark eyes that glow like the End's sky.
Dark scales on the forearms and one cheek, ember-lit at night.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goldscale.desc: Scales gone gold from generations sleeping on the hoard.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rimewyrm.desc: Ice-dragon blood, or Frostborn in the line: pale blue scales rimed with frost.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn_base.des: Teal sculk veins up the forearms.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.desc: So long in the deep dark that their colour has gone: ashen skin, white eyes, veins that pulse dim.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.geode.desc: Deepborn with Stoneborn blood: amethyst crystals grow out of the sculk on their knuckles.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.divine_base.desc: Gold filigree up the forearms and a gem on the brow.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.divine_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.starlit.desc: Born under clear peaks: pale blue skin scattered with stars that wake at night, eyes like cold light, and a wide pale blue halo floating round the neck.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.seraphic.desc: Rows of white feathers down the arms, gold at their tips, a cream skin that sheds soft motes, and a wide white halo floating round the neck.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.seraphic.trait: Trait: lands from 2 blocks higher unhurt
variant.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt_base.des: Dark seams ring the forearms; amber nodes glow in them, and the plating spreads as the form grows.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.brassbound.desc: Copper plates riveted over a warm bronze skin, a gear's teeth at the wrist and amber nodes in the plates.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.opaline.desc: A pearly shell of mint and lilac plates over pale skin, edged in a fine light that wakes in dark places.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk_base.d: Pink all through, with a wet-looking gloss down the arms and on the knuckles.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk_base.t: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.candystripe.desc: A paler pink with cream stripes slanting round the arms, like something from a sweet shop.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.berrygloss.desc: A deep berry pink dotted with glossy spots, the colour of jam on a warm day.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_base.desc: Lime to bog green, warty and blotched.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the brood's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.boggart.desc: A sickly yellow-green from the swamps, smelling of them too.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.cavegrub.desc: Pale as a grub from living under the hills, grey-green and pasty.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.orc_base.desc: The colour of old moss on a stone, scarred all over.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.orc_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the brood's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ashskin.desc: Near black, as if burnt in the hot lands they come from.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.bloodtusk.desc: A red-brown green from the badlands, the colour of dried blood.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.beastfolk_base.de: Short fur up the forearms, rounded ears and a tail: the wild's kin before they took a shape of their own.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.beastfolk_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_base.desc: Drained to a grey-blue pallor, dark rings round the eyes and a faint cold glow in the veins.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dryad.desc: Sylvans of the deep jungle with Verdant blood in the line: bark-skinned and crowned in leaves, moss on the shoulders. Among trees they stand so still that hunters walk straight past them.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dryad.trait: Trait: Verdant Bloom; the open sun mends them; fire and lava hurt them three times as much
variant.jaymoskingdoms.changeling.desc: Born in the dark forests, and never quite the child their parents expected. Their skin runs mismatched with a seam across the brow, and the woods hum when they pass.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.changeling.trait: Trait: Mirror Shift; sneaks 30% faster; 3 less armour
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sprite.desc: Born in the flower meadows, small and quick, with gossamer wings on the back and a dusting of pollen light wherever they have been.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sprite.trait: Trait: Phase Shift; floats down on gossamer wings; 3 fewer hearts, takes 20% more and hits 20% harder
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nymph.desc: Sylvans of the swamps and still pools, with Tideborn blood in them: pearled with water, ripples up the arms and a lily in the hair.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nymph.trait: Trait: Siren's Charm; breathes water and swims like a dolphin; weakens after five minutes dry
variant.jaymoskingdoms.faerie.desc: Born under the blossom trees, likelier still near an Irradiated monolith, whose glow got into their wings: butterfly-winged and glittering, crowned in flowers. They laugh at things nobody else heard.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.faerie.trait: Trait: Faerie Bargain; +1 luck; iron weapons hurt them 35% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.highelf.desc: The elves of the heights, oftenest born in sight of a Highfield monolith: tall-eared and gold-circleted, with filigree up the arms. They keep long memories and short patience.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.highelf.trait: Trait: Arcane Reflex; swings 10% faster; 2 fewer hearts
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moonelf.desc: Elves of the dark forests with Nightborn blood: silver-lined and star-freckled. Their marks shine at night and their ears are tipped in violet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moonelf.trait: Trait: Moonlit Veil; sees at night and is 5% quicker then; 12% lighter blows under the open sun
variant.jaymoskingdoms.bloodelf.desc: Elves of the hot lands with Emberborn blood: crimson sigils burn up their forearms and gold trims their ears. They are proud, and are said to be hungry.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.bloodelf.trait: Trait: Blood Frenzy; hits the wounded 10% harder; mends at three quarters of the rate
variant.jaymoskingdoms.arachnid.desc: Spider-blooded, from the webs of the dark forests: dark banded fur, a ring of extra eyes across the brow, and a pale hourglass on the back.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.arachnid.trait: Trait: Web Snare; their blows poison; fire and lava hurt them 50% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.avian.desc: Bird-blooded, born on the heights where the storms break, often with Stormborn in the line: feathers up the arms, folded wing-feathers across the back, a crest and a bright beak.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.avian.trait: Trait: Wind Burst; falls hurt from 6 blocks higher; 1 fewer heart, and blows hurt them 10% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.canine.desc: Hound-blooded, from the cold north, often with Frostborn in the line: grey fur, a pale muzzle and ruff, pointed ears and a bushy tail.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.canine.trait: Trait: Howl of the Pack; 4% quicker on foot; hunger drains 30% faster
variant.jaymoskingdoms.feline.desc: Cat-blooded, from the open grasslands: tabby stripes, tufted ears, whisker marks, and eyes that catch the dark.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.feline.trait: Trait: Pounce; nine lives (gets up once every five minutes); water and rain make them 15% weaker and slower
variant.jaymoskingdoms.kitsune.desc: Fox-blooded, from the flower meadows, with Sylvan blood: russet fur with white socks, tall ears, red cheek marks, three tails, and an orange fox-fire that sparks at night.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.kitsune.trait: Trait: Foxfire Illusion; +1 luck; 2 fewer hearts, and magic hurts them 40% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.serpen.desc: Snake-blooded, from the jungle: green scales in diamonds, a pale belly, slit eyes and a long tail.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.serpen.trait: Trait: Shed Skin; poison cannot hold them; the cold lands make them 15% weaker and 20% slower
variant.jaymoskingdoms.zombie.desc: Risen out of the bogs: rotting green flesh, torn open to the meat in places and stitched shut with thread.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.zombie.trait: Trait: Undying Hunger; +2 armour; rots under the open sun, bareheaded
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skeleton.desc: Risen from the deep places with nothing left on the bone: ribs across the chest, white forearms and a jaw that never stops grinning.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skeleton.trait: Trait: Conscript the Dead; arrows land 15% harder; 1 fewer heart, and falls and blasts hurt 50% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.wraith.desc: Risen in the dark, most often Nightborn in life: a body of pale cold mist, fading at the edges and trailing wisps off the legs.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.wraith.trait: Trait: Spectral Phase; floats down from any height; weaker under the open sun, and the holy hurt them 30% more
variant.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.desc: Risen in the Nether's soul valleys, in funeral black: a tattered shroud, wrapped arms, a bone-white jaw and a sigil that burns red on the chest.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.trait: Trait: Soul Harvest; each kill mends them; mends at half the rate
